usage: Each key under "cards" is a JSON Schema (draft-07) for one LCARdS custom card type (type: custom:<key>), stripped of editor-only metadata. "views" holds the view types (a dashboard views[] entry, type: custom:<key>) and "strategies" the dashboard strategies (a dashboard strategy: block, type: custom:<key>). Shared building blocks are in "$defs" and referenced via {"$ref": "#/$defs/<name>"}. When generating LCARdS YAML, only use properties that appear in the relevant schema (resolving any $ref against $defs); do not invent keys. Per-card files that load faster: schema/index.json.

pipeline_id.description: assist: the Assist pipeline to open (its id, or preferred)

start_listening.description: assist: start listening for speech when the dialog opens

data.description: Data for the action (perform-action), such as brightness for light.turn_on

animation.description: Visual animation triggered by user interactions or entity state changes

trigger.description: When to trigger the animation (default: on_load)
enumDescriptions: Once, when the card first renders
Every time the card appears: when the view opens, a visibility condition shows it, or you come back from another view
When the DataSource named in `datasource` changes

duration.description: Animation duration in milliseconds; left out, the preset's own duration applies (no upper limit: a slow looping background motion can take 20000 or more). Also accepts a map_range descriptor for entity-driven, live-adjusting duration on looping animations.

ease.description: Easing function (string name or object with type and params)

oneOf.description: true = loop infinitely, false = play once
Number of additional times to loop (1 = play twice total)

loop.description: Loop the animation. true = infinite, false = play once, N = loop N times. Left out, the preset decides (pulse and glow loop, most play once).

alternate.description: Whether animation should alternate direction on each loop. Left out, the preset decides.

delay.description: Delay before animation starts (milliseconds). Also accepts a map_range descriptor, matching rulesSchema's equivalent field.

entity.description: Entity ID to monitor (required for on_entity_change trigger)

attribute.description: Attribute to read instead of entity state. Applies uniformly to to_state, from_state, and the while condition. Use "brightness_pct" for a computed 0–100 light brightness percentage (avoids converting raw 0–255 values).

from_state.description: Fire-and-forget gate: Only trigger when the entity (or attribute) transitions FROM this value. The animation runs until completion and does not auto-stop a looping animation. For auto-stop on loops, use while.

to_state.description: Fire-and-forget gate: Only trigger when the entity (or attribute) transitions TO this value. The animation runs until completion and does not auto-stop a looping animation. For auto-stop on loops, use while.

check_on_load.description: Evaluate the condition when the card first loads (default: true). For while conditions, starts a looping animation immediately if the condition is already met. For to_state/from_state, plays the animation if the entity is already in to_state. Set to false to suppress the initial evaluation and only react to state transitions. (on_entity_change only)

while.description: Lifecycle condition for looping animations (requires the top-level loop: true field). The animation plays while the condition is true and stops automatically when it becomes false. Note: to_state/from_state are fire-and-forget gates: they control when the animation starts but will not stop it. Use while to auto-stop a looping animation. The 4 numeric bound keys (above/at_least/below/at_most) AND-combine when more than one is present, so a range can be expressed by combining two of them, e.g. { at_least: 20, at_most: 80 } for an inclusive range, or { above: 20, below: 80 } for an exclusive one.

state.description: Play while entity value equals this string

not_state.description: Play while entity value does NOT equal this string

above.description: Play while numeric entity value is strictly above this threshold

at_least.description: Play while numeric entity value is greater than or equal to this threshold

below.description: Play while numeric entity value is strictly below this threshold

at_most.description: Play while numeric entity value is less than or equal to this threshold

params.description: Preset-specific parameters. Shape depends on the sibling `preset` field. Values may be static or a map_range descriptor that follows an entity.

essential_motion.description: Keep playing when the device asks for reduced motion (prefers-reduced-motion). Only for motion that carries meaning, such as an alert flash; other animations jump to their end state or stay still.

enumDescriptions: CSS filters (blur, brightness, contrast, etc.) - simpler, good performance

type.description: Filter type - depends on mode (CSS: blur, brightness, etc. / SVG: feGaussianBlur, feColorMatrix, etc.)

blur.description: Gaussian blur radius, a CSS length in px.

brightness.description: 0 = black, 1 = normal, 2+ = brighter. No hard ceiling in code; 3 is a practical UI limit.

contrast.description: 0 = gray, 1 = normal, 2+ = higher contrast. No hard ceiling in code; 3 is a practical UI limit.

saturate.description: 0 = grayscale, 1 = normal, 2+ = oversaturated. No hard ceiling in code; 3 is a practical UI limit.

hue-rotate.description: Angle to rotate hue by, a CSS angle in deg (0-360 is the meaningful range; it wraps beyond that).

grayscale.description: 0 = full color, 1 = complete grayscale. CSS-spec-clamped to 0-1.

sepia.description: 0 = normal, 1 = full sepia tone. CSS-spec-clamped to 0-1.

opacity.description: 0 = fully transparent, 1 = fully opaque. CSS-spec-clamped to 0-1; values above 1 have no additional effect.

blur.description: Shadow blur radius, a CSS length in px.

color.description: Shadow color.

feGaussianBlur.description: SVG Gaussian blur: smoother than CSS blur, chains with other SVG filters.

stdDeviation.description: Amount of blur: 0 = none, higher = more blur.

feColorMatrix.description: Color transformation via matrix operations: hue rotation, saturation, luminance-to-alpha, or a custom 4x5 matrix.

oneOf.description: Saturation multiplier (type: saturate) or hue-rotate angle in degrees (type: hueRotate).
Space-separated 4x5 matrix: 20 numbers (type: matrix).
4x5 matrix as an array: 20 numbers (type: matrix).

values.description: Meaning depends on `type`. Not used when type is luminanceToAlpha. Left out: 1 for saturate (unchanged), 0 for hueRotate (no turn).

feOffset.description: Shifts the filter result by dx/dy pixels; combine with blur for shadow effects.

dx.description: Horizontal offset: positive = right, negative = left.

dy.description: Vertical offset: positive = down, negative = up.

feBlend.description: Blends the current filter result with SourceGraphic using a standard CSS blend mode.

mode.description: Blend mode: try screen/lighten after a blur for glow effects.

in2.description: The second input: SourceGraphic (the blueprint, the default), SourceAlpha, or the result of an earlier primitive.

feComposite.description: Combines the previous filter result and SourceGraphic using a Porter-Duff operator, or a custom arithmetic formula.

k1.description: Arithmetic coefficient: only used when operator is arithmetic. result = k1*i1*i2 + k2*i1 + k3*i2 + k4.

k2.description: Arithmetic coefficient: only used when operator is arithmetic.

k3.description: Arithmetic coefficient: only used when operator is arithmetic.

in2.description: The second input: SourceGraphic (the blueprint, the default), SourceAlpha, or the result of an earlier primitive.

radius.description: How far to erode/dilate, in filter units.

seed.description: Randomization seed: change for a different pattern.

feDisplacementMap.description: Warps the image based on color values from a preceding source (typically feTurbulence): wavy/liquid/turbulent distortion.

in.description: The image it warps: SourceGraphic (the blueprint, the default), SourceAlpha, or the result of an earlier primitive.

in2.description: The map that warps it: the previous primitive (the default, such as feTurbulence), SourceGraphic or SourceAlpha.

opacity.description: Band opacity (0=transparent, 1=solid). Default 0.3 in gauge mode, 1 for the shaped and ring components.

value.description: Numeric value or template resolving to a position on the track. When present (instead of min/max), renders a point marker rather than a coloured band. Supports {entity.state}, {entity.attributes.xxx}, {states.domain.object_id.state}, {datasource:name}, {config.x}, {variables.x}, and [[[JS]]] templates. (Synchronous only; no Jinja2.)

indicator.description: Per-marker indicator shape. Gauge mode: fallback chain this block → style.gauge.marker_indicator (preset default) → hardcoded defaults (triangle 20×20, rotation 180, no border). Ring (component: ring): type line (default, a radial line from the inner edge past the ring), triangle (outside the ring, pointing at it) or round (a dot on the band); align start/center/end anchors it at the inner edge, the band middle or the outer edge; size, color, border and offset.y (radial shift, positive outward) apply; rotation follows the ring.

type.description: Indicator shape type (default: triangle on a gauge, line on a ring)

align.description: Cross-axis alignment: start=left/top edge, center=middle, end=right/bottom. Overrides the preset marker_indicator.align for this range only. Default: marker_indicator.align (start) on a gauge; on a ring per type (line start, triangle end, round center).

color.description: Indicator fill color (defaults to range color). Supports state-object syntax ({ active, inactive, above:N, … }) and theme:/var()/computed colour tokens.

enabled.description: Draw an outline on the marker (default false)

color.description: Outline colour. Default theme:components.slider.indicator.border.color.

pill_style.description: Pills mode: visual appearance of the marker pill.

stroke.description: Show an outline border on the marker pill to distinguish it from neighbours

stroke_color.description: Outline border colour. Falls back to the pill fill colour (range.color) if unset.

label.description: Optional text caption shown next to the marker (gauge mode), the highlighted pill (pills mode) or outside the ring beyond the marker (ring).

text.description: Label text. Supports the full template system: {entity.attributes.xxx} / {states.entity_id.state} tokens, {{ Jinja2 }}, [[[ JS ]]], and {datasource:name} references, or a plain static string.

color.description: State-based colour of the label text. Falls back to theme:components.slider.indicator.label.color.

font_size.description: Label font size in pixels. Defaults to the gauge tick-label size.

offset.description: Pixel offset from the marker’s default label position (above the marker in horizontal orientation, beside it in vertical).

ring.description: Ring gauge configuration (used with component: ring). Angles are in degrees, 0 = top, clockwise; the value arc fills from start_angle to end_angle.

start_angle.description: Angle where the ring starts (the minimum), in degrees: 0 = top, 90 = right, -90 = left. Default -135.

end_angle.description: Angle where the ring ends (the maximum), in degrees, clockwise from start_angle. An end at or before the start wraps round; equal angles draw a full ring. Default 135 (a 270 degree sweep with the gap at the bottom).

oneOf.description: Thickness in pixels
Percentage of the ring diameter (e.g. 12%) or pixels (e.g. 14px)

thickness.description: Ring band thickness: a percentage of the ring diameter (e.g. 12%) or pixels (a number or e.g. 14px). Default 12%.

cap.description: Ends of the track and value arcs: round or flat. Default round.

track.description: The unfilled ring (the whole sweep, under the value arc)

color.description: Track colour. Supports state-object syntax and theme:/var()/computed colour tokens. Default theme:components.slider.ring.track.color.
Value arc colour. Supports state-object syntax ({ active, inactive, above:N, ... }) and theme:/var()/computed colour tokens. Default theme:components.slider.ring.fill.color.

scale.description: Ticks and value labels outside the ring: the same keys as style.gauge.scale. A tick level, or the labels, shows when its block is set.

tick_marks.description: Major and minor tick marks at value intervals

major.description: Major ticks. Shown when this block is set (enabled defaults to true).

enabled.description: Show the major ticks (default true once the block is set)

interval.description: Value units between major ticks, counted from the display minimum (default 10)

height.description: Tick length in pixels, outward from the ring (default 8)

color.description: Major tick colour. Default theme:components.slider.gauge.tick.major.color.default.

minor.description: Minor ticks. Shown when this block is set (enabled defaults to true).

enabled.description: Show the minor ticks (default true once the block is set)

interval.description: Value units between minor ticks, counted from the display minimum (default 2)

height.description: Tick length in pixels, outward from the ring (default 4)

color.description: Minor tick colour. Default theme:components.slider.gauge.tick.minor.color.default.

labels.description: Value labels at the major tick interval (tick_marks.major.interval, default 10). Shown when this block is set.

enabled.description: Show the labels (default true once the block is set)

show_unit.description: Add the unit to each label. Set false to hide it even when the entity has a unit.

unit.description: Unit suffix for the labels. Takes priority over the display unit and the entity unit_of_measurement.

color.description: Label colour. Default theme:components.slider.gauge.label.color.default.

padding.description: Gap between the ticks and the labels in pixels (default 3)

focus_ring.description: Outline the ring while it has keyboard focus (default false: most rings are used by touch). Keyboard control works either way.

padding.description: Room left outside the ring for the scale, value markers and their labels, in pixels. Worked out from them when unset; set it to line up several rings or to give long labels more room.

shaped.description: Shaped component configuration (used with component: shaped)

type.description: Shape boundary for the clip path

radius.description: Corner radius in pixels: lozenge auto = min(w,h)/2, rounded default = 8

fill.description: Value fill appearance (the “filled” portion of the shape)

color.description: Fill colour. Supports state-object syntax ({ active, inactive, above:N, … }) and theme:/var()/computed colour tokens.

text_bands.description: Band sizes (pixels reserved outside the shape body for text fields)

background.description: Shape interior background colour (the “empty” portion). Supports state-object syntax and theme:/var()/computed colour tokens.

points.description: Array of [xPct, yPct] pairs (0–1) defining polygon vertices relative to shape bounds

path.description: Raw SVG path options (shape type: path)

translate.description: Wrap path in translate(bodyX, bodyY) so coordinates are relative to the shape body origin

value_tween.description: Eases the gauge/pills track and markers between old and new positions on entity-driven state changes (does not affect direct drag interaction). Distinct from the animations array, which is trigger/preset based.

enabled.description: Enable value tweening. Automatically forced off when the OS-level prefers-reduced-motion setting is active, regardless of this value.

ease.description: anime.js v4 easing function used for the tween

targets.description: Which elements the tween applies to. All default to true.

track.description: Tween the gauge/shaped fill, the ring's value arc or the pills opacity sweep, whichever the card's track type uses.

markers.description: Tween threshold/range marker position (and, in pills mode, which pill is highlighted). Applies to `gauge`, `pills` and the ring: `shaped` never renders markers at all.

drag_badge.description: Live value badge that follows the drag position while the slider is being actively dragged by the user (never shown for entity-driven/external state changes). Mirrors Home Assistant's native slider drag badge.

enabled.description: Show a live value badge that tracks the drag position while dragging

format.description: Number formatting for the badge text

decimals.description: Fixed number of decimal places. Leave blank to use locale-default formatting.

show_unit.description: Show the unit suffix on the badge

unit.description: Unit suffix override. Leave blank to use the track's display unit (style.track.display.unit / entity unit_of_measurement).

offset.description: Pixel offset from the default anchor point (below the track in horizontal orientation, beside it in vertical).

color.description: Badge text colour. Falls back to theme:components.slider.drag_badge.text.color.

enabled.description: Show a background chip behind the badge text

color.description: Badge background colour. Falls back to a theme-aware translucent surface colour.

enabled.description: Show a border around the badge

color.description: Badge border colour. Falls back to theme:components.slider.border.color.default.

release.description: What happens to the badge when the drag is released (pointer-up), before the entity commit.

behavior.description: fade = fade out over release.duration; instant = hide immediately on release. Automatically forced to instant when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

duration.description: Fade-out duration in milliseconds (only used when behavior = fade)

view_layout.description: Placement in a custom view layout (e.g. grid-area), read by the view.

visibility.description: Home Assistant visibility conditions: the card shows only while they hold.

layout_options.description: The older name of grid_options, read by Home Assistant.

lcards-elbow.title: LCARdS Elbow Card Configuration
lcards-elbow.description: Complete configuration schema for lcards-elbow custom card with LCARS corner treatments. Supports dynamic theme integration via HA-LCARS input_number helpers (input_number.lcars_horizontal, input_number.lcars_vertical).

variables.description: Your own named values, available to templates as variables.<name> and {variables.<name>}.

debug_zones.description: Outline every zone on the card (development aid).

entity.description: Home Assistant entity ID to control or monitor (format: domain.object_id)

interactive.description: When false, hover colour changes and hover animations are suppressed. The cursor defaults to the arrow unless overridden via style.cursor. Tap/hold actions still fire if configured. Left out, an elbow is interactive when it has a tap, hold or double tap action or an entity its default tap (toggle) can switch, and decorative (false) otherwise.

id.description: Unique card identifier for rule targeting, animations, and debugging (alphanumeric, underscore, hyphen)

tags.description: Tags for bulk rule targeting and grouping. Allows applying rules to multiple cards at once using tag selectors.

overflow.description: CSS overflow shorthand on the card host element (sets both axes unless overridden per-axis).

overflow_x.description: CSS overflow-x on the card host element. Overrides the overflow shorthand for the horizontal axis.

overflow_y.description: CSS overflow-y on the card host element. Overrides the overflow shorthand for the vertical axis.

z_index.description: CSS z-index stacking order on the card host element.

type.description: Elbow or bar shape: header-left/right and footer-left/right put the corner at that side; the other types are bars and shaped ends

enumDescriptions: Simple: Single elbow with one curved corner
Segmented: Double concentric elbows with gap (TNG Picard aesthetic)

oneOf.description: Width of vertical sidebar (pixels)
Use 'theme' to bind to input_number.lcars_vertical, or a CSS length expression (e.g. 'clamp(60px, 8vw, 120px)')

bar_width.description: Width of vertical sidebar. Use number for static value or "theme" for dynamic binding to HA-LCARS input_number.lcars_vertical

oneOf.description: Height of horizontal bar (pixels)
Use 'theme' to bind to input_number.lcars_horizontal, or a CSS length expression (e.g. 'clamp(20px, 4vh, 60px)')

bar_height.description: Height of horizontal bar. Use number for static value or "theme" for dynamic binding to HA-LCARS input_number.lcars_horizontal. Defaults to bar_width if not specified.

diagonal_angle.description: Cut angle in degrees for the diagonal-cap and bar-slant types (default 45; 90 = square). 'theme' binds to input_number.lcars_elbow_angle.

oneOf.description: Outer corner radius in pixels

Keyword or CSS expression. Keywords: 'auto'/'arm_width' = bar_width/2, 'arm_height' = bar_height/2, 'arm_max' = max(bar_width,bar_height)/2 (recommended), 'arm_min' = min(bar_width,bar_height)/2, 'arm_fill' = max(bar_width,bar_height). CSS: e.g. 'clamp(30px, 4vw, 60px)'

outer_curve.description: Outer corner radius. Keywords: 'auto'/'arm_width' = bar_width/2 (LCARS classic), 'arm_height' = bar_height/2, 'arm_max' = max(bar_width,bar_height)/2 (recommended for paired elbows, same as auto for typical configs), 'arm_min' = min(bar_width,bar_height)/2, 'arm_fill' = max(bar_width,bar_height) (fills dominant arm). Or set explicit pixels.
outer_curve.$comment: Arc tangent points always arrive at 0° to their edges. Render-time clamp: outerRadius ≤ min(card_w, card_h) keeps tangent points within card viewport. Use arm_max for consistent paired elbows; equals auto (bar_width/2) when bar_width >= bar_height.

oneOf.description: Inner corner radius in pixels

Keyword or CSS expression. Keywords: 'auto' = outer_curve/2 (LCARS formula), 'arm_width' = bar_width/2, 'arm_height' = bar_height/2, 'arm_max' = max(w,h)/2, 'arm_min' = min(w,h)/2, 'arm_fill' = max(w,h). CSS: e.g. 'clamp(10px, 2vw, 30px)'

inner_curve.$comment: Unset: outer_curve less the bar when the curve is bigger than the bar (an even bend), else outer_curve / 2; auto: outer_curve / 2. Keywords use the same bar dimension formulas as outer_curve, independently of the outer value.

oneOf.description: 'card' (default) clamps outer_curve to min(card_w, card_h), keeps arc within viewport. 'none' disables clamping: arc is exactly the computed value; SVG overflow:hidden clips any overflow. Use 'none' for consistent paired elbows regardless of card height.
Explicit px ceiling for outer radius: hard cap independent of card or arm dimensions

outer_curve_clamp.$comment: Issue #361: two same-config elbows in differently-sized cards get different radii because 'card' clamp uses the card height. Set 'none' to decouple radius from card height.

color.description: Segment colour (string or state-based object)

segments.description: Configuration for segmented style (double concentric elbows with gap)

gap.description: Gap between outer and inner segments (pixels)

entity_id.description: Entity this segment follows: its colour state map matches this entity's state, and its taps act on it (default: the card's entity).

oneOf.description: 'theme' (binds to input_number.lcars_vertical) or a CSS length expression (e.g. 'clamp(60px, 8vw, 120px)')

bar_width.description: Vertical bar thickness (pixels, CSS length, or 'theme' for input_number.lcars_vertical, 90 until it exists). Required.

oneOf.description: Keyword: 'auto'/'arm_width', 'arm_height', 'arm_max' (recommended), 'arm_min', 'arm_fill', or CSS expression

outer_curve.description: Outer corner radius. Keywords: 'auto'/'arm_width'=bar_width/2, 'arm_height'=bar_height/2, 'arm_max'=max(w,h)/2 (recommended), 'arm_min'=min(w,h)/2, 'arm_fill'=max(w,h). Or explicit pixels.

oneOf.description: CSS length expression (e.g. 'clamp(15px, 2vw, 30px)')

inner_curve.description: Inner corner radius (pixels or CSS length; unset: outer_curve less the bar when the curve is bigger than the bar, so the bend keeps one width, else outer_curve / 2)

outer_curve_clamp.description: Cap on this segment's outer_curve: 'card' (default) = min(card width, card height), 'none' = no cap, a number = that many px.

diagonal_angle.description: Cut angle in degrees for the diagonal-cap types (default 45; 90 = square). 'theme' binds to input_number.lcars_elbow_angle.

entity_id.description: Entity this segment follows: its colour state map matches this entity's state, and its taps act on it (default: the card's entity).

oneOf.description: 'theme' (binds to input_number.lcars_vertical) or a CSS length expression (e.g. 'clamp(40px, 6vw, 80px)')

bar_width.description: Vertical bar thickness (pixels, CSS length, or 'theme' for input_number.lcars_vertical, 90 until it exists). Required.

oneOf.description: Keyword: 'auto'/'arm_width', 'arm_height', 'arm_max' (recommended), 'arm_min', 'arm_fill', or CSS expression

outer_curve.description: Outer corner radius. Omit for auto concentric (outer_segment.inner_curve - gap). Keywords: 'auto'/'arm_width'=bar_width/2, 'arm_height'=bar_height/2, 'arm_max'=max(w,h)/2 (recommended), 'arm_min'=min(w,h)/2, 'arm_fill'=max(w,h).
outer_curve.$comment: Auto-calculation (when omitted): outer_segment.inner_curve - gap. Keyword modes use bar dimensions of inner_segment.

oneOf.description: CSS length expression for inner corner radius

inner_curve.description: Inner corner radius (pixels or CSS length; unset: outer_curve less the bar when the curve is bigger than the bar, so the bend keeps one width, else outer_curve / 2)

outer_curve_clamp.description: Cap on this segment's outer_curve when it sets one (a concentric inner segment follows the outer segment's clamp): 'card' (default) = min(card width, card height), 'none' = no cap, a number = that many px.

diagonal_angle.description: Cut angle in degrees for the diagonal-cap types (default: the outer segment's angle; 90 = square). 'theme' binds to input_number.lcars_elbow_angle.

frame.description: Frame elbow (elbow.type: frame): a 2 to 4 sided rectangular border with per-side thickness and per-corner curves. Every length is px (a number) or a CSS length (a string such as clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px)). Its colour is elbow.segment.color.

bar_width.description: Thickness of the left and right sides (default: 90).

bar_height.description: Thickness of the top and bottom sides (default: bar_width).

outer_curve.description: Outer radius of every corner (default: half of bar_width).

inner_curve.description: Inner radius of every corner (default: outer_curve less the side thickness, so each bend keeps one width, when the curve is bigger than the side; else half of outer_curve).

segments.description: style: segmented only: a second, inner ring inside the frame.

gap.description: Space between the outer and inner ring (default: 4).

inner_frame.description: The inner ring: the same keys as the frame itself, plus its own colour.

bar_width.description: Thickness of the left and right sides (default: 28).

bar_height.description: Thickness of the top and bottom sides (default: bar_width).

outer_curve.description: Outer radius of every corner (default: half of bar_width).

inner_curve.description: Inner radius of every corner (default: outer_curve less the side thickness, so each bend keeps one width, when the curve is bigger than the side; else half of outer_curve).

color.description: Colour of the inner ring (default: the outer ring colour, elbow.segment.color). State maps supported.

cursor.description: CSS cursor style shown when hovering over the elbow. Overrides the automatic cursor derived from the interactive flag.

shape_texture.description: Canvas texture/animation rendered inside the elbow shape boundary

oneOf.description: State-based values: keys are states (default, active, inactive, unavailable, ...), values are numbers

speed.description: Animation speed multiplier. Supports state-based object.

config.description: Preset-specific configuration. Supports entity-reactive values: map_range descriptor or template strings.

filters.description: Visual filters applied to entire elbow (CSS and SVG filter primitives)

symbiont.description: Embed another Home Assistant card inside the elbow content area with optional style imprinting

enabled.description: Enable symbiont card embedding

overflow.description: CSS overflow for both axes of the symbiont container. Overridden per-axis by overflow_x / overflow_y. Default: hidden.

overflow_x.description: CSS overflow-x for the symbiont container (horizontal axis). Overrides overflow shorthand.

overflow_y.description: CSS overflow-y for the symbiont container (vertical axis). Overrides overflow shorthand.

position.description: Padding within the elbow content area (px)

size.description: Constrain the embedded card to an explicit size within the content area (placed by `anchor`). Omit for the full content area.

width.description: Width: a number is px; a string is any CSS length (e.g. 50%, 12rem).

height.description: Height: a number is px; a string is any CSS length.

anchor.description: Where a sized embedded card (`size`) sits within the content area.

imprint.description: Style imprinting: injects resolved styles into the embedded card shadow root

background.description: Background colour to inject into embedded card. Null = do not imprint.

color.description: Text colour to inject into embedded card. Null = do not imprint.

font_size.description: Font size to inject (e.g. "14px"). Null = do not imprint.

font_family.description: Font family string to inject. Null = do not imprint.

match_host.description: Derive border radius from elbow inner arc geometry

oneOf.description: Top-left border radius (px)
Use 'match' to mirror the elbow's inner arc radius

top_left.description: Top-left border radius: number (px) or 'match' to mirror elbow inner arc

oneOf.description: Top-right border radius (px)
Use 'match' to mirror the elbow's inner arc radius

top_right.description: Top-right border radius: number (px) or 'match' to mirror elbow inner arc

oneOf.description: Bottom-left border radius (px)
Use 'match' to mirror the elbow's inner arc radius

bottom_left.description: Bottom-left border radius: number (px) or 'match' to mirror elbow inner arc

oneOf.description: Bottom-right border radius (px)
Use 'match' to mirror the elbow's inner arc radius

bottom_right.description: Bottom-right border radius: number (px) or 'match' to mirror elbow inner arc

custom_style.description: Raw CSS injected into child card shadowRoot after imprint styles. Does not require UIX. Applied only while imprint is enabled.

card.description: Any valid Home Assistant card configuration (type + properties). uix (and legacy card_mod) blocks are passed through as-is; imprint styles apply after them.

view_layout.description: Placement in a custom view layout (e.g. grid-area), read by the view.

visibility.description: Home Assistant visibility conditions: the card shows only while they hold.

layout_options.description: The older name of grid_options, read by Home Assistant.

lcards-chart.title: LCARdS Chart Card Configuration
lcards-chart.description: Complete configuration schema for lcards-chart custom card (v1.18.0+ nested structure)

variables.description: Your own named values, available to templates as variables.<name> and {variables.<name>}.

debug_zones.description: Outline every zone on the card (development aid).

id.description: Custom card ID for rule targeting (optional - auto-generated if omitted)

tags.description: Tags for bulk rule targeting and grouping. Allows applying rules to multiple cards at once using tag selectors.

sources.description: Chart series. Each item plots an entity (history or long-term statistics) or a named DataSource buffer.

entity.description: Entity to plot (history is fetched from Home Assistant)

attribute.description: Plot this attribute instead of the state

statistics.description: Use long-term statistics instead of state history (sensors with a state_class)

name.description: Legend name (default: entity friendly name or source id)

unit.description: Unit shown in tooltips and axis labels (default: entity unit_of_measurement)

type.description: Per-series chart type for mixed charts

stroke_dash.description: Dash length for this series (0 = solid)

yaxis_id.description: Id of the yaxis[] entry this series uses

datasource.description: Name of a DataSource (in data_sources or defined by another card)

buffer.description: Processor key to plot instead of the raw values

name.description: Legend name (default: entity friendly name or source id)

unit.description: Unit shown in tooltips and axis labels (default: entity unit_of_measurement)

type.description: Per-series chart type for mixed charts

stroke_dash.description: Dash length for this series (0 = solid)

yaxis_id.description: Id of the yaxis[] entry this series uses

graph_span.description: How much time the chart shows, e.g. 6h, 2d, 1w, 1mo (default 24h)

span.description: Align the time window to calendar boundaries and/or shift it

start.description: Start the window at the beginning of the current minute/hour/day/week/month/year (it then lasts graph_span)

end.description: End the window at the end of the current minute/hour/day/week/month/year (it then starts graph_span earlier)

offset.description: Shift the window, e.g. -1d for the same window yesterday

yaxis.description: Y axes for multi-axis charts. Series pick one with yaxis_id; series without one use the first axis.

id.description: Axis id referenced by series yaxis_id

opposite.description: Draw the axis on the right

overflow.description: CSS overflow shorthand on the card host element (sets both axes unless overridden per-axis).

overflow_x.description: CSS overflow-x on the card host element. Overrides the overflow shorthand for the horizontal axis.

overflow_y.description: CSS overflow-y on the card host element. Overrides the overflow shorthand for the vertical axis.

z_index.description: CSS z-index stacking order on the card host element.

xaxis_type.description: X-axis type. Default: category for horizontal bar charts (one time label per bar), datetime for the other time charts

style.description: Nested style configuration for chart appearance

colors.description: Complete colour configuration for all chart elements

fill.description: Fill configuration for area and bar charts

size.description: Marker size in pixels (0 hides the markers). Default: 0, or 6 for scatter charts

show.description: Show/hide legend. Default: on for pie, donut, polarArea and radialBar (it names the slices and gauges), off for other chart types

font_size.description: Legend font size in pixels. Default: the base font size (style.typography.font_size) plus 2; 12 for scatter and polarArea

decimals.description: Round displayed values to N decimal places (axis labels, tooltips, and data labels)

font_family.description: Font family. Default: the theme's chart font (the components.chart.fontFamily token, the LCARS font)

enabled.description: Enable monochrome theme

zero_line.description: Draw a horizontal reference line at 0

thresholds.description: Horizontal reference lines at fixed values

color.description: Line and label colour
boxPlot: colour of the boxes (upper and lower quartile). Default: the theme accent colour

gauge_start_angle.description: radialBar: arc start angle in degrees (default -90)

gauge_total.description: radialBar: show the sum of all gauges in the centre

gauge_end_angle.description: radialBar: arc end angle in degrees (default 90)

group_rows.description: rangeBar: put bars with the same label on one row

show_labels.description: rangeBar: show labels on the bars

chart_options.description: Raw ApexCharts options (highest precedence - overrides all other settings)

grid_options.description: Placement in a sections view (columns, rows), read by Home Assistant.

view_layout.description: Placement in a custom view layout (e.g. grid-area), read by the view.

visibility.description: Home Assistant visibility conditions: the card shows only while they hold.

layout_options.description: The older name of grid_options, read by Home Assistant.

variables.description: Your own named values, available to templates as variables.<name> and {variables.<name>}.

debug_zones.description: Outline every zone on the card (development aid).

oneOf.description: decorative: generated values; data: your rows. Defaults to data when rows are set, otherwise decorative.

format.description: Generated value format: digit (0042), float (42.17), alpha (AB), hex (A3F1) or mixed

refresh_interval.description: Regenerate values every N ms (0 = never)

refresh_cells.description: Fraction of cells that change on each refresh (1 = all)

rows.description: Data rows. Each row is a list of cells, or { values, style, header }.

header.description: Header row: header defaults plus header_style

cell_tap_action.description: Tap action for every entity cell that has no tap_action of its own (e.g. { action: more-info })

pipeline_id.description: assist: the Assist pipeline to open (its id, or preferred)

start_listening.description: assist: start listening for speech when the dialog opens

perform_action.description: Action to perform (format: domain.action); the current Home Assistant name for service

data.description: Data for the action (perform-action), such as brightness for light.turn_on

navigation_path.description: Path to navigate to (must start with /)

url_path.description: url only: the address to open, in a new tab

entity.description: Entity ID (format: domain.object_id)

target.description: What the action acts on: entity_id, device_id, area_id, floor_id or label_id (and exclude), passed to Home Assistant as the action's target

browser_mod.description: fire-dom-event: what browser_mod runs, in its own grammar (service and data, e.g. service: browser_mod.popup), read from the ll-custom event

card.description: fly-to, set-clock and set-model-scale: the id of the astrometrics card to act on (any card on the same dashboard or open in the same browser). On the astrometrics card's own points and objects, leave it out for that card.

view.description: fly-to only: a named view of that card (camera.views).

point.description: fly-to only: a point id of that card to fly to (wins over view).

type.errorMessage: Only "line", "control", and "shape" overlay types supported. Use LCARdS cards for buttons/charts.

kind.description: Shape overlays only: geometry primitive. polyline uses `points` (+ optional `closed`); rect/circle use `position` + `size` like control overlays.

points.description: Shape overlays (kind: polyline) only: ordered vertex list. Each entry is either [x, y] in viewBox units or a static anchor-name string. Minimum 2 points.

closed.description: Shape overlays (kind: polyline) only: close the path back to its first point and allow `style.fill`.

entity.description: Line overlays: entity to bind style.color to (state-color object); see style.color. Not used by control overlays, which already have their own entity via the embedded card.

state_attribute.description: Line overlays: attribute whose string value is matched against style.color state keys instead of the raw entity state (e.g. "fade", "true"); mirrors the button card's state_attribute, scoped per-line

ranges_attribute.description: Line overlays: attribute value compared against above:/below:/between: keys in style.color; mirrors the button card's ranges_attribute, scoped per-line

animations.description: Line and shape overlays: animations on this overlay (same syntax as card animations; e.g. trigger: on_show with preset: draw to draw the line in each time the card appears)

style.description: Line/shape overlay styling (color, width, opacity, dash pattern, markers, gradient/pattern fill, etc.)

color.description: Stroke color: a literal/token/CSS value, or a state-color object resolved against `entity` (same state-color pipeline as buttons/sliders; requires `entity` to be set)

width.description: Stroke width in viewBox units (alias: stroke_width)

line_cap.description: Stroke line cap style, applied to every dash segment (use with dash_array "0,N" and line_cap: round for true circular dots). Has no visible effect on a solid (non-dashed) closed shape.

line_join.description: Stroke line join style at path vertices. Meaningful for polyline and rect; no effect on circle/ellipse.

miter_limit.description: Miter limit, used when line_join is "miter"

fill.description: Fill color: a literal/token/CSS value, or a state-color object resolved against `entity` (same state-color pipeline as `color`). Only visible on closed shapes (rect, circle, closed polyline).

pattern.description: Pattern fill configuration (dots, lines, diagonal, grid, or custom SVG content)

marker_start.description: Marker (arrowhead/dot/etc.) at the path start. Polyline shapes only; meaningless for rect/circle.

marker_mid.description: Marker at each interior path vertex. Polyline shapes only; meaningless for rect/circle.

marker_end.description: Marker at the path end. Polyline shapes only; meaningless for rect/circle.

animatable.description: Whether this overlay is eligible as an anime.js animation target

position.description: Control overlay, or shape overlay (kind: rect/circle): named anchor (e.g. "hub") or coordinates [x, y] (each a number, or a percentage of the view box such as "50%"). The anchor is the center of the card/shape by default.

size.description: Control overlay, or shape overlay (kind: rect/circle) size [width, height] in SVG coordinates. For kind: circle, an ellipse is drawn with rx=width/2, ry=height/2 (use equal width/height for a perfect circle).

attachment.description: Which point of the control card aligns with the anchor position. Default: center

position_side.description: Control overlays only: when position references another control's id, which point of that target control to align to (instead of its center). Ignored for named-anchor or coordinate positions.

card.description: Home Assistant card config embedded in this control overlay

obstacle.description: Control overlay, or shape overlay (kind: rect/circle): when true, lines routed auto, smart or grid go around its box (position + size), keeping the routing clearance. Default false: lines may cross it.

oneOf.description: Extra entity IDs this control overlay depends on, beyond what static analysis of `card` can detect; they are added to the control's change detection. Entries that are not entity IDs are ignored (data-source names here never refreshed anything and were dropped).

Control overlays only: this control receives every HASS update unconditionally, bypassing the per-control entity-diff optimization. Use when the embedded card's entity dependencies genuinely can't be enumerated (e.g. wildcard/device-class auto-discovery alert cards). Prefer the array form when possible.

locked.description: Control/shape overlays only: when true, MSD Studio's editor canvas disables drag/resize/vertex-editing for this overlay (Edit/Duplicate/Delete in the list panel remain available). Editor-only; has no effect on runtime rendering or line overlays.

anchor.description: Line overlays: start-point anchor name or [x,y]. Control overlays: deprecated alias for position; use position instead.

anchor_side.description: Line overlays: which side of the anchor overlay the line departs from (top, bottom, left, right, center). Left out: the side nearest the other end

anchor_gap.description: Line overlays: gap in SVG units between line endpoint and anchor edge

attach_to.description: Line overlays: destination anchor name, overlay ID, or [x, y]

attach_side.description: Line overlays: which side of the attach_to overlay the line arrives at (top, bottom, left, right, center). Left out: the side nearest the other end

attach_gap.description: Line overlays: gap in SVG units between line endpoint and attach_to edge

route.description: Routing algorithm. auto (recommended): always full pathfinding (obstacle avoidance, trunk bundling, crossing avoidance) regardless of whether obstacles/channels are present. direct: straight line, no pathfinding. angled: a short straight stub out of anchor_side (and into attach_side when set), then one straight run at any angle between them; no pathfinding (stub length: stub_length). manual: explicit waypoints. Escape hatches for the cheap/non-participating alternative: manhattan (fixed 2-elbow shape, no pathfinding, no bundling, no crossing avoidance) or grid (pathfinding + bundling/crossing avoidance, without the extra local-search refinement pass smart adds). smart is what auto resolves to.

waypoints.description: Array of waypoints for manual routing. Each waypoint is a coordinate pair [x, y], optionally [x, y, radius] to override this corner's rounding radius (round) or chamfer size (bevel); omit the 3rd slot to inherit corner_radius. A waypoint can also be an anchor name string. Line will pass through waypoints in order.

route_hint.description: Initial segment direction hint: empty/auto (geometry-based), xy = horizontal first, yx = vertical first

route_hint_last.description: Final segment direction hint: empty/auto (same as route_hint), xy = vertical last, yx = horizontal last

route_channels.description: Array of channel IDs this line should route through

clearance.description: Minimum clearance around obstacles in viewBox units (overrides global default)

corner_style.description: Line overlays, or shape overlays (kind: polyline): how corners are rendered. For shape kind: rect, maps to rx/ry (round only); no effect on circle/ellipse.

corner_radius.description: Line overlays, or shape overlays (kind: polyline): corner cut size in viewBox units: arc radius for round corners, or diagonal chamfer size for bevel corners. For shape kind: rect, sets rx/ry directly.

corner_radius_mode.description: Line overlays only (routing behavior, not shape overlay rendering): whether corner_radius is a target or a hard requirement for round/bevel corners. auto (default): corner size may shrink so the router stays free to avoid forcing a detour or an unnecessary line crossing near tight geometry. forced: always reserves room for the full configured radius, matching pre-2026.07 behavior; can force routing detours or crossings.

corner_room_weight.description: Line overlays only, round/bevel corner_style: how strongly the smart-routing refinement pass tries to recover this line's full corner_radius when a tight detour would otherwise shrink it. On by default (card-wide default in routing.corner_room_weight); a route that leaves more room for the configured corner is preferred over the plain-cheapest route, when the difference is small. Set to 0 on a line to opt it out.

corner_angle.description: Bevel corners only (line overlays, or shape overlays of kind: polyline): angle of the diagonal cut in degrees (0=cut flush with incoming edge, 90=flush with outgoing edge, 45=symmetric diagonal), matching the elbow card's diagonal-cap angle

stub_length.description: Line overlays only: overrides the mandatory cardinal stub length (viewBox units) departing/arriving anchor_side or attach_side, instead of the router's own auto-computed floor (which scales with grid_resolution and can force a longer straight lead-out than a specific line's own geometry needs). Leave unset for the default. Going below one grid cell risks re-triggering an internal same-cell short-circuit; use window.lcards.debug.msd.routing.inspect(id).meta.debug to see the router's own resolved value first.

smoothing_mode.description: Line overlays, or shape overlays (kind: polyline) only: path smoothing algorithm

smoothing_iterations.description: Line overlays, or shape overlays (kind: polyline) only: number of smoothing iterations to apply (1 when a smoothing mode is set and this is left out)

animations.description: Animations that bulk-target overlays in the shared overlay group by CSS selector (data-overlay-id, class, etc.), e.g. animate every overlay whose id starts with "shield_" with one declaration, instead of repeating the animation on each overlay. Same target/targets selector syntax as base_svg.animations and per-overlay animations; matches shape, line, and control overlays uniformly.

routing.description: Global line routing configuration (lines can override with per-line properties)

default_mode.description: Card-wide override for every line whose own route is unset/auto (per-line route: still wins). auto (default): full pathfinding: obstacle avoidance, trunk bundling, crossing avoidance (this is what an unset line gets). manhattan/grid: force the whole card to the cheap/non-participating or no-refinement alternative instead. smart: same as auto, spelled out explicitly.

grid_resolution.description: Grid cell size for grid-based routing (viewBox units; values below 5 are coerced to 32). Unset by default; auto-scales from view_box size instead of a fixed number (~1/12th of the shorter dimension, clamped to [16, 64]; 64 shown here is that ceiling, not a fixed default)

min_stub_length_factor.description: Multiplier on the resolved grid_resolution for the minimum mandatory lead-out/lead-in stub every line reserves before routing runs. 1 (default) reproduces the router's own "at least one grid cell" floor; raise it to reserve more room for large corner_radius values, lower it (e.g. on a small view_box, where a flat floor would otherwise be disproportionately long) to let lines turn sooner

turn_penalty.description: A* cost for changing direction: higher values produce straighter paths with fewer turns

route_hint_penalty.description: A* cost for a first/last move that disagrees with route_hint/route_hint_last (soft, so obstacles still win)

smoothing_iterations.description: Number of smoothing iterations (1 when a smoothing mode is set and this is left out)

smart_proximity.description: Proximity band for smart routing (viewBox units)

smart_detour_span.description: Maximum detour distance for smart routing (viewBox units)

smart_max_extra_bends.description: Maximum additional bends allowed by smart routing

smart_min_improvement.description: Minimum cost improvement to accept detour (viewBox units)

corner_room_weight.description: Card-wide default strength for recovering a line's full corner_radius near tight detours (see the per-line field of the same name for the full explanation). On by default; the LCARS rounded-corner look is the intended out-of-the-box result. Set to 0 to disable card-wide; individual lines can still opt back in via their own corner_room_weight.

channel_force_penalty.description: Penalty for lines outside forced channels

channel_prefer_bias.description: Per-cell A* discount for traveling along a prefer channel's own direction (scaled by channel weight)

channel_avoid_bias.description: Per-cell A* penalty for entering an avoid channel (scaled by channel weight and channel_avoid_multiplier)

trunk_bundling_enabled.description: Lines whose paths run close and parallel spontaneously bundle together and branch apart where needed

trunk_proximity.description: Maximum distance to a trunk lane to be considered "nearby" (viewBox units)

trunk_min_overlap.description: Minimum shared travel distance for joining a trunk to be worthwhile (viewBox units)

trunk_min_length.description: Minimum straight-run length to register as a new joinable trunk (viewBox units)

trunk_max_join_candidates.description: Maximum number of discovered trunks a single line will try to chain through

trunk_bundle_discount_cap.description: Longest stretch (viewBox units) of a trunk or discoverable channel a line joined on its own that earns the bundling reward: a long detour along one never pays for itself. Channels a line lists in route_channels are not capped

trunk_bundle_weight.description: Reward strength for joining a discovered trunk (same role as a channel's weight)

trunk_line_spacing.description: Default lane spacing for lines bundled on a discovered trunk (viewBox units)

trunk_discovery_max_passes.description: Cap on discovery passes before rendering, so every line's trunk/crossing data is known regardless of YAML order (safety limit against rare oscillation)

crossing_avoid_enabled.description: Penalize a line's path for cutting orthogonally across another already-routed line's segment

crossing_avoid_bias.description: Per-cell penalty for crossing another line's segment: a deterrent, not a hard block

crossing_min_length.description: Minimum straight-run length to register as avoidable (viewBox units), smaller than trunk_min_length so short stub legs are still avoidable

cost_defaults.description: Cost function weights for routing algorithms

bend.description: Cost weight for each bend/elbow in path

proximity.description: Cost weight for proximity to obstacles

channels.description: Named routing channels for bundling/separating lines with optional forced routing

mode.description: Channel behavior: prefer=encourage bundling, avoid=stay away, force=must route through

direction.description: Flow direction through channel (auto = infer from shape: wide=horizontal, tall=vertical)

weight.description: Channel influence strength (0-1, higher = stronger pull/push)

line_spacing.description: Gap between bundled lines in viewBox units (for prefer/force modes)

discoverable.description: Whether nearby lines that do NOT list this channel in their own route_channels may still spontaneously bundle into it. Default true matches automatic zero-config bundling; set false to scope this channel to only the lines that explicitly reference it via route_channels.

triggers_update.description: Card-wide escape hatch: every control overlay receives every HASS update unconditionally, bypassing the per-control entity-diff optimization for the whole card. Discouraged; prefer the per-overlay control `triggers_update: all` scoped to just the problem control.

grid_options.description: Placement in a sections view (columns, rows), read by Home Assistant.

view_layout.description: Placement in a custom view layout (e.g. grid-area), read by the view.

visibility.description: Home Assistant visibility conditions: the card shows only while they hold.

layout_options.description: The older name of grid_options, read by Home Assistant.

camera.description: The camera: the view shown first, named views to fly between, drag and zoom controls and their limits.

view.description: The named view shown first. Default: the first of views; with no views the camera frames the whole scene. Or a guided tour: { entity, views } flies to views[n] when the entity's value is n (from 0), or to the view its text state names.

anyOf.description: A guided tour: the camera follows an entity (an input_number stage, an input_select of view names).

entity.description: The entity whose value picks the view.

attribute.description: Read this attribute instead of the state.

views.description: The stops in order: a number n flies to the nth (from 0, rounded, clamped). A stop is a view name, or { view, date, rate } to set the scene clock there too. Leave out when the state names the view.

view.description: The named view to fly to.

date.description: Set the scene date there: now or an ISO date.

rate.description: Set the date's rate there: live, days per second, or with a unit as the time slider shows it (1 h/s, 30 d/s, 1 y/s).

views.description: Named views (keys are your names). Fly between them with a tap_action (action: fly-to, view: <name>).

additionalProperties.description: A named camera view. The camera orbits a target: yaw turns round it, tilt raises it, distance moves away.

target.description: What the camera looks at: a point id or [x, y, z]. Default: where the camera looked before.

oneOf.description: A point id
Scene coordinates [x, y, z], scene units

yaw.description: The way the camera faces, degrees: 0 faces north (the default camera), 90 faces east. Default 0 when the card opens on the view; flown to, a view without yaw keeps the current one.

tilt.description: Camera height angle, degrees: 0 level with the target, 90 straight down. Default 35.

distance.description: Distance from the target, scene units.

fov.description: Vertical field of view, degrees (perspective only). Default 40. On a card wider than 2:1 it narrows so the view is never wider than on a 2:1 card (no wide-angle stretching at the sides).

projection.description: perspective: far things look smaller. orthographic: no perspective (a flat map); distance then sets the zoom.

warp.description: Stars and dust streak while the camera flies here (warp). Default camera.warp.

controls.description: Drag to orbit, mouse wheel or pinch to zoom, shift-drag, right-drag, middle-drag, a touchpad two-finger swipe or two fingers on a touch screen to pan, double-tap blank space to zoom in, arrow keys when focused. false: the camera only moves by fly-to and auto_rotate.

drag.description: What a one-finger or left-button drag does. orbit: turn round the target (shift or right button pans). pan: move the view (shift or right button orbits). A locked tilt always pans.

pan.description: What panning moves along. screen: the screen's left, right, up and down, so a side view pans up and down. ground: across the ground plane only, the target keeps its height.

zoom_to.description: Where the wheel and pinch zoom toward. cursor: the spot under the pointer stays put. target: straight in and out from the centre.

wheel.description: What wheel events do. auto: a mouse wheel zooms and a touchpad two-finger swipe pans (shift: orbits), told apart by the events. zoom: every wheel event zooms. pan: every wheel event pans. A pinch always zooms.

follow.description: After a fly-to lands on a point (a tap, a fly-to action, a view that targets it), the camera keeps the point at its centre while it moves; orbit and zoom still work round it. A pan, a double-tap zoom, a tap on blank space or another fly-to lets go. false: the camera stays where it landed.

zoom_step.description: Distance factor of one zoom step (double-tap, zoom buttons, plus and minus keys). Default 2: each step halves the distance.

double_tap.description: A double-tap or double-click. In blank space, zoom flies in one zoom step toward that spot, which becomes the centre (shift: zoom out); on a point, it flies in close to the largest object standing there (a few times its size). none: nothing. Taps on tappable objects are never affected.

buttons.description: On-card camera buttons: an LCARdS D-pad in the theme's D-pad colours (the arms pan, the centre resets to the start view, the corners zoom in and out (left) and fly forward and back (right)), with the time slider under it. Press and hold keeps moving. true for all of them in the bottom right; an object to choose. Default off.

position.description: Where the buttons sit on the card.

size.description: How big the D-pad is, px across. Default 180.

pan.description: The arms pan. false: they are dimmed and do nothing.

zoom.description: The left corners zoom in (top) and out (bottom). false: they are dimmed and do nothing.

travel.description: The right corners fly forward (top) and back (bottom): camera and target move together along the view, as the W and S keys. false: they are dimmed and do nothing.

reset.description: The centre resets (flies back to the start view). false: it is dimmed and does nothing.

scale.description: The model size button beside the pad: real size or visible size (model_scale), as the V key. Shown only when a model is drawn at its real size. false hides it.

time.description: The time slider. speed: how fast the scene's motion runs (time_scale: spins, scans, drift), from held to four times as fast. date: the scene clock (clock), with the date, its rate from a year a second backward to a year a second forward, and NOW. both: either, with a switch. true (the default): both when the card has a clock, else speed. false hides it. It changes the view only, not the config.

hide.description: When the buttons hide. idle: they fade out after a few seconds without input on the card and come back on any pointer movement, touch or key. never: always shown. toggle: a small button folds them away and back.

limits.description: Where drag and zoom stop: [min, max] pairs. A tilt range of one value (e.g. [90, 90]) locks the tilt, and a one-finger drag then pans (a map).

tilt.description: Lowest and highest tilt, degrees. Default [-90, 90].

distance.description: Nearest and farthest distance, scene units. Default: 1 to 100,000, widened for a scene at true scale (down to half its smallest object, out to 20 times its size).

yaw.description: Yaw range, degrees. Default: no limit.

target.description: Where the point the camera looks at may go, so panning cannot lose the scene. A sphere ({ radius, center }) or a box ({ x, y, z } ranges, an axis left out is free); false for no limit. Default: a sphere 1.5 times the size of the scene round its centre.

center.description: Sphere centre [x, y, z], scene units. Default: the centre of the scene.

x.description: Box: lowest and highest x, scene units.

y.description: Box: lowest and highest y, scene units.

z.description: Box: lowest and highest z, scene units.

auto_rotate.description: Turn the camera round its target, degrees per second (negative: the other way). 0 is off. Pauses while dragging; off under reduced motion.

fly_duration.description: How long a fly-to takes, ms. Under reduced motion the camera jumps.

ease.description: Easing of a fly-to (an anime.js easing name, such as inOutCubic, outQuad, linear).

warp.description: Every fly-to streaks the stars and dust (warp); a view's own warp wins. Or { entity } (and attribute): fly-tos streak while it is on (on, true, or a number above 0), such as an input_boolean. Off under reduced motion.

oneOf.description: Warp fly-tos from an entity

entity.description: The entity that makes fly-tos streak while it is on.

attribute.description: Read this attribute instead of the state.

backdrop.description: What is behind the scene objects.

stars.description: Stars at infinity: they turn with the camera and never move when it pans. true for the defaults, or settings.

brightness.description: Each star's brightness is picked at random between these [faintest, brightest], 0 to 1 (the seed picks the same ones every time). Default [0.35, 1].

color.description: Star colour. Default var(--lcards-moonlight).

colors.description: Several star colours, picked at random per star (wins over color).

opacity.description: Fades the whole star layer, 0 to 1: every star's brightness is multiplied by it.

seed.description: Random seed: the same seed places the same stars.

streak.description: How long stars and dust streak during a warp fly-to (camera.warp or a view's warp), a multiple of the usual length; 0: never.

spectrum.description: Streaks split into colour: a Doppler shift of each star's own colour, violet toward the tail and red toward the head (white stars show the whole rainbow). true, or { direction }. Default off.

direction.description: doppler: violet toward the tail, as a real Doppler shift. reverse: violet toward the head.

dust.description: Depth dust: faint particles that fill the space round the camera wherever it goes. They stay put as it moves, so every move shows depth, and streak in a warp fly-to. true for the defaults, or settings.

count.description: How many particles (about half of them are within reach of the camera at any time).

radius.description: How far round the camera the dust reaches (it fades out there), scene units. Smaller is denser and shows depth on smaller moves. Default 1.5 x the scene's radius.

brightness.description: Each particle's brightness is picked at random between these [faintest, brightest], 0 to 1. Default [0.35, 1].

color.description: Particle colour. Default var(--lcards-moonlight).

colors.description: Several colours, picked at random per particle (wins over color).

opacity.description: Fades the whole dust layer, 0 to 1: every particle's brightness is multiplied by it.

spectrum.description: Streaks split into colour (a Doppler shift, as on the stars). true, or { direction }. Default off.

direction.description: doppler: violet toward the tail. reverse: violet toward the head.

labels.description: How labels are drawn: text defaults for every label, your own label styles, pixel snapping.

font_weight.description: Font weight: CSS keyword (normal, bold) or numeric value (100–900)

font_family.description: CSS font-family (single font, comma-separated stack, or CSS variable)

letter_spacing.description: Space between letters: px (a number) or a CSS letter-spacing such as 0.1em or 2px. Default normal.

background_padding.description: Space between the text and the sides of its background box, px.

background_radius.description: Corner radius of the background rect (px).

background_width.description: Fixed explicit width of the background rect (px). Overrides auto-sizing from text metrics. Text will overflow if content is wider than this value.

background_min_width.description: Minimum width of the background rect (px). Auto-sizes to text width but never smaller than this value. Safe for dynamic content.

default.description: Text keys every label on this card inherits (font_family, text_transform, letter_spacing, ...), over the built-in styles.

styles.description: Label styles by name: change a built-in (title, major, minor, tiny) or add your own; a point picks one with style.

additionalProperties.description: A label style: text keys (font_size, color, font_weight, ...) and priority.

font_weight.description: Font weight: CSS keyword (normal, bold) or numeric value (100–900)

font_family.description: CSS font-family (single font, comma-separated stack, or CSS variable)

letter_spacing.description: Space between letters: px (a number) or a CSS letter-spacing such as 0.1em or 2px. Default normal.

background_padding.description: Space between the text and the sides of its background box, px.

background_radius.description: Corner radius of the background rect (px).

background_width.description: Fixed explicit width of the background rect (px). Overrides auto-sizing from text metrics. Text will overflow if content is wider than this value.

background_min_width.description: Minimum width of the background rect (px). Auto-sizes to text width but never smaller than this value. Safe for dynamic content.

priority.description: Which label wins when two overlap (higher wins).

overlap.description: Labels of this style are never hidden by another label (they still move to a free side when they can).

Every label on the card: never hidden when labels overlap (each still moves to a free side of its point when it can). false hides the lower-priority one, which keeps busy scenes readable. A style or a point can set its own.

snap.description: Round label positions to whole px (crisper text on weak devices; fast motion looks steppier). Default: sub-pixel.

units.description: What one scene unit is (m, km, au, ly or pc): positions, sizes and distances are in it. Optional: a scene can use any units of its own (scene units); naming them lets a system (type: system) give its own, models and starter parts start at their real size, and bodies (body: points) sit at real distances. Naming them does not rescale what is already there.

model_scale.description: How models drawn at their real size (no size of their own) start: real (the default) keeps them in proportion, however small that is on screen; visible draws each at least 40 px across, real again once it is larger. The size button by the camera buttons, the V key and set-model-scale actions switch it on screen; that is not saved.

look.description: Draw the scene as an LCARS diagram, realistically, or both: diagram shows the objects and points with look: diagram, realistic those with look: realistic, mixed (the default) both; ones without a look always show. A change crossfades. Or { entity } (and attribute) whose state names the look, such as an input_select with the options diagram, realistic and mixed (any case).

oneOf.description: The look from an entity

entity.description: The entity whose state (or attribute) names the look.

attribute.description: Read this attribute instead of the state.

warp.description: Go to warp: the backdrop stars and dust streak along the view and the warp starfield (spectrum streaks) streams past behind the scene, at warp_factor; false drops out of warp. Or { entity } (and attribute): at warp while it is on (on, true, or a number above 0), such as an input_boolean. Nothing under reduced motion. (camera.warp is different: streaks during a fly-to.)

oneOf.description: Warp from an entity

entity.description: The entity that engages warp while it is on.

attribute.description: Read this attribute instead of the state.

warp_factor.description: How fast the stars stream at warp, 1 to 9.9 (default 6). Can follow an entity ({ entity, output }), such as a slider, or a template.

anyOf.description: A template that gives the number: [[[ return ... ]]], {{ ... }} or {entity.state}.

time_scale.description: Speed of the scene's motion (orbits, spins, drift, scans, trails): 1 as configured, 0.5 half speed, 2 twice as fast, 0 holds it still. Faster than 4 can be typed. The sky, the scene clock (clock) and the camera are not affected. The time slider (camera.buttons.time) changes it on screen. Can follow an entity ({ entity, output }) or a template.

anyOf.description: A template that gives the number: [[[ return ... ]]], {{ ... }} or {entity.state}.

clock.description: The scene's date: it starts at date and runs on at rate. Body points, body spheres and rings, orbit rings and the sky follow it. The time slider (camera.buttons.time: date), set-clock actions and lcards.set_clock change it on screen.

date.description: The date the scene starts at: now (the default) or a date and time. In YAML an ISO date or date and time (2026-10-30, 2026-10-30T12:00:00Z; a date alone is midnight UTC). Or { entity } to follow a date and time helper (an input_datetime), or a template.

rate.description: How fast the date runs: live (real time, the default), paused (0), or an amount of time per second. In YAML days per second (1 is a day a second, 30 a month, 365.25 a year; 0 holds it; negative runs back), or with a unit as the time slider shows it: 1 h/s (an hour a second), 30 d/s, 1 y/s, -1 d/s (units s, min, h, d, w, mo, y). Or { entity, output } to follow an entity, or a template.

anyOf.description: A template that gives the number: [[[ return ... ]]], {{ ... }} or {entity.state}.

points.description: Named points with optional labels and markers (the placement system).

objects.description: What is drawn: grids, volumes, spheres, models, images, glows, nebulae, rings, paths and beams.

id.description: Unique card identifier for rule targeting, animations, and debugging (alphanumeric, underscore, hyphen)

tags.description: Tags for bulk rule targeting and grouping. Allows applying rules to multiple cards at once using tag selectors.

oneOf.description: Card height in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 56 = 56px)
Card height with CSS unit (e.g. 200px, 50vh, 10em) or a CSS function: calc(), min(), max(), clamp(), var()

height.description: Card height. Bare integer = px (default 400); CSS units accepted (50vh). The scene fills the card.

z_index.description: CSS z-index stacking order on the card host element.

variables.description: Your own named values, available to templates as variables.<name> and {variables.<name>}.

view_layout.description: Placement in a custom view layout (e.g. grid-area), read by the view.

visibility.description: Home Assistant visibility conditions: the card shows only while they hold.

layout_options.description: The older name of grid_options, read by Home Assistant.

lcards-layout-view.title: LCARdS Layout View
lcards-layout-view.description: Dashboard view type whose whole view is a CSS grid. Uses the lovelace-layout-card grid-layout schema: a `layout` block plus `cards` placed by `view_layout.grid-area`.

lcars-shell.title: LCARS Shell Dashboard Strategy
lcars-shell.description: Dashboard strategy that generates a full LCARS shell (header, sidebars, content panel) on a custom:lcards-layout-view. Set it as the dashboard's `strategy:` block. The room light list needs auto-entities (HACS).

room_selector_entity.title: Room Controller Entity
room_selector_entity.description: Controls the room light controller. input_select or select: its options become the room list (entity mode). input_text: room list is built from your Home Assistant area registry automatically; the selected area is stored in this entity (auto-areas mode). Leave blank to show a placeholder.

page_selector_entity.title: Page Selector Entity
page_selector_entity.description: input_select entity used for sidebar page/section navigation

top_bar_entity.title: Top Bar Toggle
top_bar_entity.description: input_boolean that shows/hides the top header bar (also bound to the first header-left button)

right_sidebar_entity.title: Right Sidebar Toggle
right_sidebar_entity.description: input_boolean that shows/hides the right sidebar (also bound to the second header-left button)
